_note: The long rig check, once per rig and after any hardware, driver or OS change: about 25 minutes. The display for 2 min; the frame test at 60, 30, 20 and 50 fps (50 divides no common refresh), 1 min each, idle and with every core busy; 20 passes of every code; 850 flashes. Offsets to a fraction of a ms, their drift, missed refreshes and pulses, the TR on this PC's clock.

text: Photodiode on the patch, bottom-right; microphone at the ear if there is one.
The controls check will ask for each button: press it on the participant's device.

_triggers_note: null until this rig's are set: the first rig check asks for them (a preset or your own) and saves them here; the Triggers tab changes them. They must be the session's own: with sync 'wait' the check waits for the scanner and counts its pulses.
